data.action: 右手握摇杆，左手停在落爪按钮，盯住箱内呱太；机械爪悬在玩偶上方。
data.camera: medium shot, eye level, three-quarter side view including hands and crane cabinet interior
data.description: 学园都市游戏中心里，美琴换上奶油白与砖红拼色棒球夹克、白T恤和深色牛仔短裤，短裤内搭不透黑色打底裤。她右手握住抓娃娃机摇杆，左手停在落爪按钮上，目光紧追玻璃箱内的限定呱太。近处控制台有投币槽，箱内玩偶铺在绒布台面上，机械爪悬在目标上方；后方成排街机沿过道延伸，地面还能看见相邻机台的彩色反光。机内白光照亮绿色玩偶和她靠近玻璃的脸，右侧屏幕蓝粉光染在夹克袖边，玻璃保留细微反射与较暗的框边——「往左一点……再往后一点……抓住了！哈哈！看到了吗！只要本王牌出手，就没有抓不到的限定呱太！」
data.lighting: white crane-cabinet light on face and toy; blue-pink arcade screen glow from the right
data.location: 大型游戏中心抓娃娃机前，街机列与过道向后延伸
data.promptProse: Her right hand grips the joystick while her left hovers over the drop button: Misaka Mikoto is concentrating on the limited Gekota plush inside the crane cabinet. Her cream varsity jacket with brick-red sleeves opens over a white T-shirt, paired with dark shorts over opaque black leggings. The near control deck includes the coin slot; beyond its glass, the green plush rests on a fabric-covered platform with the claw directly above it. Rows of neighboring cabinets recede along a visible aisle, their colors reflecting lightly on the floor. Show her face, separate hand contacts and the toy in an eye-level three-quarter medium view. White cabinet light brightens her face and the plush, while blue-pink screen glow from the right colors the sleeve edge. Dark cabinet framing separates these lit surfaces, with faint glass reflections still visible.
data.title: 御坂美琴 · 游戏厅
